content.title: About
content.content: Woven wheat crackers with reduced sodium are crisp, dry biscuits made from whole‑grain wheat. They contain only about 150 mg of sodium per 100 g, making them suitable for low‑salt diets. The flavor is mild with a slight nutty note, and the texture is crunchy and flaky.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The woven technique creates a distinctive pattern and a more uniform crumb structure.
Sodium reduction is achieved by using natural herbs and spices instead of added salt.
Whole‑grain wheat retains more fiber and B‑vitamins than refined white crackers.
The product does not contain added gluten‑free agents, but it does contain gluten from the wheat itself.
Packaging is typically recyclable, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain wheat provides fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt helps control blood pressure and eases kidney load.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Crackers deliver sustained energy through slow‑release glucose.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B3 and B6 aid metabolism and support the nervous system.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: A 30 g serving provides roughly 120 kcal, fitting well into calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: People with wheat allergy or celiac disease should avoid this product.

items.title: Additive sensitivity
items.content: Some variants may contain preservatives or flavorings that could affect sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the crackers as a snack, pair them with low‑fat cottage cheese, hummus, avocado spread, or use them as a base for canapés. They are convenient to pack in a bag or backpack.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight bag or container. For longer storage (over 3 months) keep refrigerated to maintain crispness.
